effects.formatted: Reinitialise the effects of an item with a level equal to or less than 0

type.name: Reinitialise the effects of an item with a level equal to or less than

items.name: Minor New Leaf Orb (linked)

items.description: You were warned to stay away, that death awaited you there on the cursed island, deep in that dark cave. But you didn't listen. Despite attempts to sear more of these warnings into your mind, you threw caution to the wind.
items.name: Cire Momore's Wax

items.description: The armour grew more wicked as the heart within was twisted.
items.name: Cire Momore's Heart

items.description: Contrary to what many geologists think, this ore is not volcanic in origin; the fire it spawned from is anything but natural. Put a block of ashenstone against your ear, and you'll hear the distant sound of the Sea of Dust... "For dust you are, and to dust you shall return." Redfis's motto sounds like a judgement.
items.name: Ashenstone

items.description: This crystal reduces recycling's impact on the prism's durability by half for the next twelve hours.
items.name: Inhibitor Crystal

items.description: This strange crystal can influence minds and erase any hostility directed at the prism, thereby protecting it from attacks for the next twelve hours. Note that when this crystal is used, the modules on the prism are deactivated.
items.name: Pacifier Crystal

items.description: This flower isn't born from the earth's bowels but from the Bitter-Hammers' expertise. It is the key to opening a path to the terrifying Cire Momore. Give it to a Protector of Ashenstone to receive a blessing that may enable you to take down the terrible suit of armour.
items.name: Ashenstone Flower

items.description: These brambles usually form a barrier around the walls of Belladonna's Castle simply to discourage adventurers from venturing inside.
items.name: Ephedryan Bramble

items.description: Perceptors never move without nails in their shoes. Better traction, more effective attacks... they really do rely on these nails.
items.name: Perceptor Nails

items.description: Perceptors' garments shouldn't make them too hot or leave them too cold. That's why their tunics are generally made with this mesh material.
items.name: Perceptor Mesh

items.description: This magical pole displays the emblem of the alliance employing the Perceptor on its banner. That way anyone who dares attack will know what to expect.
items.name: Perceptor Pole

items.description: Just because Perceptors keep their weapons hidden doesn't mean they don't have any. Once properly honed, this blade will become one of their fearsome daggers.
items.name: Perceptor Blade

items.description: Perceptors' cuirasses are always equipped with this kind of plate. Solid yet lightweight, it blocks incoming attacks without slowing down the Perceptor's movements.
items.name: Perceptor Plate

items.description: Perceptors will only carry chests that are secured with this lock. They believe it's the only kind that can truly keep the items inside safe and secure.
items.name: Perceptor Lock

items.description: Perceptors often have to deal with unscrupulous adventurers who try to steal the loot they're guarding. These straps are perfect for keeping a firm hold on the bags they carry, even during intense activities like chases or fights.
items.name: Perceptor Strap

items.description: This is one egg that won't weigh down your digestion.
items.name: Chimeric Egg

items.description: Cut with temporal powder to keep it fresh longer, this flour can sometimes be a bit hard to digest. That said, it used to contain sawdust and powdered scaraleaf chitin, so count your blessings.
items.name: Contraband Flour

items.description: Forged to last, this chest is a lot tougher than you, yet not nearly as heavy.
items.name: Forgechest

items.description: The recipe for this spicy kebab is an homage to Lektor the Kanniball. Savour each juicy bite slowly... but be careful! It can also be quite prickly on the tongue, and not just because of the spices.
items.name: Lektor Kebab

items.description: Developed by a famous dark miner, this alloy has excellent mechanical strength. Admittedly, it also has a bothersome tendency to explode. But this apparent design flaw may actually be an intentional feature, given that its inventor had a lot of Rogue friends.
items.name: Fyredite

items.description: Whether you're more into nuggets or getting around quickly, you'll need these parts to craft the module that's right for you.
items.name: Module Parts

items.description: This key opens up unexpected possibilities.
items.name: Premium Key

items.description: Assemble all twelve pieces of the Menologium, and you can proudly brandish this mythical shield until Silvosse smashes you to bits like so many puzzle pieces.
items.name: Menologium Piece

items.description: As regular and precise as Xelor's Clock itself, this accessory is essential to keeping time during the Clockwork Ball, or to staying on the beat in any situation.
items.name: Clockwork Metronome

items.description: With its golden gleam, this pebble could make you rich, even if it doesn't quite bring a ray of sunshine into your life.
items.name: Radiant Pebble

items.description: Cleats have appeared on the bottom of your shoes. Very handy to avoid injury on steep or slippery surfaces. Ridiculous at a fancy ball, so choose the right moment to use this rune.
items.name: Ra Psh Res Rune

items.description: Unbelievable – this rune places a thin layer of ice under your shoes. Useful for winter sports or for playing dubious pranks.
items.name: Ra Psh Dam Rune

items.description: You didn't really understand everything the Ankamian was trying to explain, but he did assure you that this machine will be able to process information from your fights. However, it is missing a number of parts for it to work properly.
items.name: Analysis Module

items.description: This small machine can produce bits of paper.
items.name: Print Module

items.description: Infused with the power of the Master of Dreams, this ruby will enable your analyser to capture the essence of any dreams you face in battle.
items.name: Dream Ruby

items.description: This box equipped with a lens seems to be able to capture high-resolution images, whatever that's supposed to mean.
items.name: Optical Module

items.description: An essential ingredient for an effective gobmetic.
items.name: Mauve Liquid

items.description: This croquette has been infused with the all the hidden potential of Scaraleaves. Feeding it to your legendary pet will give your pet new powers.

effects.formatted:
Scaraleaf's Carapace (level 200):
• When the bearer suffers an attempted AP removal, they gain 75% of their level as shield for 1 turn (stackable 1 time).

items.name: Scaraleaf-Infused Croquette

items.description: This croquette has been infused with the all the hidden potential of Thoronduddleswells. Feeding it to your legendary pet will give your pet new powers.

effects.formatted:
Thoronduddleswell's Patience (level 200):
• When the bearer uses no MP during their turn, they gain 2 MP for their next turn.

items.name: Thoronduddleswell-Infused Croquette

items.description: This croquette has been infused with the all the hidden potential of Leopenas. Feeding it to your legendary pet will give your pet new powers.

effects.formatted:
Leopena's Perseverance (level 200):
• When the bearer uses no MP during their turn, they gain 1 AP for their next turn.

items.name: Leopena-Infused Croquette

items.description: This croquette has been infused with the all the hidden potential of Bambootos. Feeding it to your legendary pet will give your pet new powers.

effects.formatted:
Bambooto's Serenity (level 200):
• When the bearer uses no MP during their turn, they gain 3 Range for their next turn.

items.name: Bambooto-Infused Croquette

items.description: This croquette has been infused with the all the hidden potential of Pingwinkles. Feeding it to your legendary pet will give your pet new powers.

effects.formatted:
Pingwinkle's Comfort (level 200):
• At the end of each turn, the bearer is healed for 3% of their health for each adjacent allied fighter.

items.name: Pingwinkle-Infused Croquette

items.description: It may be only virtual, but it's still a super-duper collector's stuffed toy!
items.name: Stuffed Nomoon

items.description: This rune will absorb Earth elemental damage.
items.name: Ra Earth Res Rune

items.description: This rune will absorb Neutral elemental damage.
items.name: Ra Neutral Res Rune

items.description: This rune will absorb Fire elemental damage.
items.name: Ra Fire Res Rune

items.description: This rune will absorb Water elemental damage.
items.name: Ra Water Res Rune

items.description: Inexplicably, you believe this rune is lucky. It should help you avoid any unfortunate blows.
items.name: Ra Cri Res Rune

items.description: This rune will absorb Air elemental damage.
items.name: Ra Air Res Rune

items.description: Children love Mama Ayuto's pies, especially when they're chucked in the face of anyone who threatens the Imps. What's the secret to her success? A long-lasting pastry, as crisp as a Crackler, that only Ayuto can break. It's hardly surprising that some crafters use it to improve the structural integrity of their creations and tempt their customers.
items.name: Mama Ayuto Pie Crust

items.description: When you see the number of the Captain's bones in circulation, you realise that the illustrious Chafer must have had a thousand and one radii, as many tibias and an incalculable number of ribs.
items.name: Captain Chafer's Bone

items.description: Keep away from crates of fireworks and Rogue bombs, or your career as a crafter will be cut as short as that hair.
items.name: Dark Vlad's Flaming Hair

items.description: This rune will enable you to reflect damage more easily.
items.name: Pa Dam Ref Rune

items.description: This stone can be upgraded.
items.name: Special Soul Stone for Small Souls

items.description: This stone can be upgraded.
items.name: Special Soul Stone for Average Souls

items.description: This stone can be upgraded.
items.name: Special Soul Stone for Big Souls

items.description: This stone can be upgraded.
items.name: Special Soul Stone for Huge Souls

items.description: This stone can be upgraded.
items.name: Special Soul Stone for Gigantic Souls

items.description: This magical artefact combines the effects of all five elements.
items.name: Pandawushu Artefact

items.description: Kabombz tufts are much bushier during the season of Rest. They also take on a blue hue similar to Osavannah down-and-outback.
items.name: Kabombz Tuft

items.description: Unlike scaraleaf, scurvion, or Tanuki entrails, Bzzulky ones are actually very appetising! What do you mean, "yuck"? At least say "zzkkbz".
items.name: Bzzulky Entrails

items.description: This insect juice could've been added to that forbidden soup, but given the colour, it would've discouraged anyone from taking a ladleful. That being said... According to some entomologists, it has undeniable medicinal value. But you still have to get over the wretched flavour.
items.name: Bzzoctor Juice

items.description: Like a skeleton Rhineetle's bones, this skull shouldn't exist. But isn't it just like the inhabitants of divine dimensions to be four-legged miracles?
items.name: Kamikabz Skull

items.description: The elasticity of this unlikely cartilage is characteristic of the physical and intellectual gymnastics that Quadrabz are capable of. They may have water on the brain, but they know how to use it! Curious and inventive, these Kabombz are considered geniuses... among insects and Iops, anyway.
items.name: Quadrabz Cartilage

items.description: Some bold zoologists have claimed that the leaf on the front of these undies isn't actually a leaf... Is it fact or simply a theory? The answer may lie in the pain experienced by the Bzzegg Supervisor when you ripped off his loincloth.
items.name: Bzzegg Supervisor's Leafy Undies

items.description: Nobz bozhzrbz qzzznbz! Zlzzbz Bzzzlkzbz krzzhbz znbz bzzzkkbz.
items.name: Bzzulky Bzzegg

items.description: Zzalbz bzzzkkbz manbz zzalbz zmallbz brozhzrbz.
items.name: Bzzoctor Bzzegg

items.description: Walkbz onbz bzzzkkbz? Boombz! Brakbz bzzzkkbz? Bzgbz boombz!
items.name: Kamikabz Bzzegg

items.description: Nobz pzzbz zoobz manzbz bzzzkkbz znbz onzbz bazkzzbz.
items.name: Quadrabz Bzzegg

items.description: With its thick chitin carapace, the Bzzegg Supervisor looks like a gobbowler. Even so, it's unlikely you'll ever see it in a fair contest: it would probably be expelled for unsportsmanlike eggsplosions.
items.name: Bzzegg Supervisor Carapace

items.description: Just a few drops of this juice will transform your dishes into a real treat.
items.name: Fish Juice

items.description: Carved from bone, this comb allows the Rhoarim to stay presentable when the hunting season arrives, as their mane regains its splendour.
items.name: Rhoarim Comb

items.description:
Divination using bones is not commonplace, and for good reason: it's a brutal art that requires you to kill a living thing to collect their remains. You'll thus discover the fate of everyone linked to the victim.
Of course, you can also wait for the donor to die of natural causes and for their organs to turn to dust before using their bones – but then the prophecies won't be fresh.
items.name: Voracle Divinatory Bone

items.description: Voracles' hair tends to be more unruly than their peers'. That's why the priestesses like to blow it out. They start by getting the hair wet, then they use hot air from a campfire to quickly dry it. The hairdo keeps its shape and takes on a smoky scent, with an extra charge for kebab if it's dinner time.
items.name: Voracle Blowout

items.description: This plait was created with an ancestral method known only to the Rhoarim. It's so tight that it'll become a fearsome weapon when you stick a sharp object in it. When Killtamers let their hair down, their beauty rivals their brutality... but few have witnessed this and lived to tell the tale.
items.name: Killtamer Plait

items.description: A Touslecat's muscular body protects their allies. Their fringe, meanwhile, is a shield for their eyes. But watch out, as it can be troublesome the thicker it gets – they won't be able to see enemies coming.
items.name: Touslecat Fringe

items.description: According to a tradition that is outdated yet still very popular among Lionosas, a hunter's hair represents their rank. The Ripper's mane is so perfectly brilliant, there's no doubt about her position at the top. Whatever you decide to do with it, be sure to treat it with the utmost respect, as it symbolises immense power.
items.name: The Ripper's Mane

items.description: While they may appear to lack finesse and elegance, Touslecats are the Rhoarim who care most about their image. They use their robust physique to protect the hunters. The other Lionosas typically show their thanks with a bandana. So this item is cherished by the Touslecats, who wear it all the time.
items.name: Touslecat Bandana

items.description: They say the Killtamers' bone weapons are crafted from the remains of their first prey. Many bone daggers are carved during this ritual so the hunter will have enough to last them a lifetime.
items.name: Killtamer Bone Dagger

items.description: When provoked, the Ripper lets her beastliness take over. Cruelty and barbarism are guaranteed. Sharp spikes come flying out of her hands, and her name takes on its full meaning as she rips her victims' flesh from their bones. She hits so hard and violently that a claw sometimes breaks off, like this one.
items.name: The Ripper's Claw

items.description: Like most supervisors, the Bzzegg Supervisor doesn't seem to do much apart from hitting random buttons every so often. You want to supervise the checkpoint? Then you'll need this key.
items.name: Key to the Bzzegg Supervisor's Checkpoint

items.description: With this key, you'll be able to hunt in the Venerable One's Thicket... or be hunted, should you run out of arrows or your popgun jams up at the wrong time.
items.name: Key to the Venerable One's Thicket

items.description: The key to a dungeon where you can get ripped.
items.name: Key to the Ripper's Altar

items.description: Since Kabombz have six legs, they can generously offer some to others.
items.name: Kabombz Leg

items.description: You'd expect oddnivore teeth to be very... odd, but they aren't. Just another odd quirk of nature? Or perhaps the influence of a contrary spirit that passed through Osavora.
items.name: Oddnivore Tooth

items.description: In a tribe where hair indicates social status, a good shampoo is everything. This one only contains natural products the Rhoarim find in the Osavannah. It strengthens hair and gives it a splendour that even the stylist in Astrub would be jealous of.
items.name: Rhoarim Shampoo

items.description: Relative to Gargandyas, this piece of skin is microscopic. If it was proportional to one of your many flakes of skin, you could use it as canvas to set up a circus tent.
items.name: Graogarm Scale

items.description: Seeing this skin may make yours crawl...
items.name: Oddnivore Skin

items.description: Thanks to their lamps, flashiraffes serve as lampposts for other animals, who can get home at night with less fear of potential attacks.
items.name: Flashiraffe Lamp

items.description: While they don't have the flashiraffe's eye level, the rabbilope's big ears enable them to locate predators from kilokametres away in the Osavannah.
items.name: Rabbilope Ear

items.description: A distant cousin of the betapir, the brutapir has a smaller snout but a bigger body overall. Its ability to puff up with air to intimidate predators and rivals is also strangely similar to Sufokian merdiodons.
items.name: Brutapir Snout

items.description: The mighty heapotamus has an incredibly powerful jaw, which can crush kilopods of food as well as the limbs of reckless hunters.
items.name: Heapotamus Jaw

items.description: Using their stretchy tongues, goatphibians can catch Kabombz in midair and also reach things that are normally inaccessible, like fruit hanging in trees or even their own backsides.
items.name: Goatphibian Tongue

items.description: This super-soft, silver-coloured pelt taken from the Venerable One would make an excellent head covering or a very nice coat.
items.name: Sleeping Venerable One Mane

items.description: Oddnivores' golden ivory is highly prized in the World of Twelve, and it's the main reason they're hunted by poachers. It has a wide range of uses in crafting weapons, jewellery, statuettes, and even cufflinks. Does that justify the mass slaughter of innocent animals? That's for you to decide.
items.name: Flashiraffe Horn

items.description: Ground into powder and mixed with various beverages, rabbilope horns are said to increase desire and fertility. It's never been proven, but lots of people still believe it anyway.
items.name: Rabbilope Horn

items.description: The poor brutapir will have a tusk time defending itself without this.
items.name: Brutapir Tusk

items.description: You may have a hard head, but a heapotamus's is harder.
items.name: Heapotamus Bony Forehead

items.description: During the birthing season, male goatphibians fight to win the females' favour. These hard-fought jousts can be extremely violent, and they sometimes leave the two combatants stuck with their horns entangled for days. Interestingly, though, this forced proximity often results in long-lasting friendships once the altercation is forgotten.
items.name: Goatphibian Horn

items.description: These heavyweight horns can be assembled to form a powerful hunting bow. What would a big ape have done with such a weapon?
items.name: Sleeping Venerable One Horn

items.description:
This chunk of metal hasn't benefited from any special treatment... Not yet, anyway.
Would you like your own? Head to the Voyagers' outpost in Osavora!
items.name: Untreated Metal

items.description:
This stone may look like a small chunk of bronze, but it won't keep you from getting bronzed... It's an excellent insulator, though.
Would you like your own? Head to the Voyagers' outpost in Osavora!
items.name: Insulating Ore

items.description:
Theoretically, this liquid strips metal and scrubs goblin brains. But in practice, goblins don't have brains... So the acid is only good for stripping metal. But it does an excellent job!
Want to get a bottle of it? Head to the Voyagers' outpost in Osavora!
items.name: Hydrogoblic Acid

items.description:
Galvanisation is the process of coating an object with a thin layer of metal to protect it from corrosion. Did you think it was a magical thing that could bring the dead back to life with thunderbolts? You read too much science friction.
To obtain a pinch of this salt, head to the Voyagers' outpost in Osavora!
items.name: Galvanising Salt

items.description: The best way to get fresh and tasty fat is to harvest it directly from an oddnivore. Whether the creature offers it willingly doesn't matter for a recipe to be successful.
items.name: Oddnivore Fat

items.description: This broth has an especially strong smell. After making it, the Rhoarim will often cool it out in front of their huts, so then the smell won't linger inside for weeks on end.
items.name: Meat-and-Bone Broth

items.description: If improperly cooked or not ripened, the fruit of the baobeard can be toxic. To make sure not to get anyone sick, keep track of its source; better to collect it from a crate in the Rhoarim village than from a tree in the Osavannah.
items.name: Monkey Bread

items.description: This remarkably flexible heapotamus bony forehead can be shaped into a hunting tool.
items.name: Flexible Bony Forehead

items.description: This dense yet surprisingly light stone was formed in a brutapir's stomach. It is used by the Rhoarim for its purported medicinal properties, as well as to fashion hunting tools.
items.name: Dense Bezoar

items.description: These long hairs are highly resistant. When properly woven together, they form rope that's strong enough to be used for hunting tools. And with the right treatment, they can be used to make Rhoarim clothing.
items.name: Oddnivore Hair

items.description: You nicked this nut from the Kabombz reserve.
items.name: Kabombz Nut

items.description: This oil is a concentrate of lipids with various health benefits that the Rhoarim keep stocked in their village.
items.name: Sundelion Oil

items.description: This fat is packed with nutrients, no doubt owing to their protein-rich diet.
items.name: Kabombz Larva Fat

items.description: This salty-tasting liquid puts you in a blissful state, ideal for pondering the consequences of your actions.
items.name: Delicious Graogarm Tear

items.description: According to the hunter-eater, this marrow tastes amazing when you fry it. Maybe you can overlook its origin just this once...
items.name: Rhoarim Marrow

items.description: This blood comes from an old wound of the Graogarm, which only reopens when its blood starts to boil during the hunting season.
items.name: The Devourer's Fiery Blood

items.description: This intestine is perfect for making a variety of sausages. Luckily, the Rhoarim have already taken care of cleaning it for you!
items.name: Oddnivore Intestine

items.description: These petals can be consumed raw, but a certain hunter recommends frying them in grease to get deliciously airy chips.
items.name: Sundelion Petal

items.description: These pappi can cause an intense allergic reaction in Twelvians. When cooked properly, however, they're a great seasoning for a sauce or soup.
items.name: Spiced Killersilk Pappus

items.description: With exceptional nutritional qualities, this drop of nectar is meant to feed the Kabombz colonies' queens.
items.name: Drop of Nectar

items.description: This prime cut, taken from an animal in the birthing season, has a rich taste that will take you back.
items.name: Juicy Oddnivore Meat

items.description: During the season of rest, Gargandyas's breath floats up to the sky before condensing and falling back down as rain in the dimension. This liquid could have many useful properties, but adding it to a vinaigrette wasn't your first thought.
items.name: Gargandyas's Liquid Breath

items.description: These plant-like antennae will give your salad a nice crunch.
items.name: Kabombz Antennae

items.description: This Kabombz egg has been marinating for a very long time, which suffused it with a unique flavour. Your stomach may or may not be able to withstand it.
items.name: 100-Year-Old Bzzegg

items.description: Strangely, this egg doesn't contain any larvae. As it serves no purpose for their species, the Kabombz have it stored separately, and they won't begrudge you for adding it to your unusual dishes.
items.name: Unfertilised Bzzegg

items.description: Located near the stomach, this area is supposedly a reservoir of fat inherited from the early species of oddnivore. It enables the heapotamus to survive extreme conditions. At least, that's what you heard... But as you look at your trophy, a simpler explanation comes to mind: this specimen was simply larger than other ones.
items.name: Heapotamus Primordial Pouch

items.description: Are the Rhoarim upset because someone made their fur fly, or did someone make their fur fly because they... Oh, you read the other descriptions, and you reckon we're phoning it in? You think we're loafing about? These allegations are deeply upsetting.
items.name: Upset Rhoarim Hair

items.description:
Are the oddnivores upset because their teeth are getting pulled, or are their teeth getting pulled because they're upset?
... What do you mean, we already pulled this on you with the Kabombz legs?
items.name: Upset Oddnivore Tooth

items.description: Are the Kabombz upset because their wings are getting clipped, or are their wings getting clipped because they're upset? All we know is they won't be sprouting wings any time soon.
items.name: Upset Kabombz Leg

items.description: Albeit different from a dragon's breath, the sun-eating titan's fire burns just the same.
items.name: Gargandyas's Sacred Fire

items.description: As you look at this astral stone, your eyes slowly close, ready to transport you to a new dream.
items.name: Prysmaradite Fragment

items.description: When you dream, you sometimes remember who you are... but when you wake, you forget, time and again. Gaze deeply into this reflection to remember what really matters.
items.name: Dream Reflection

items.description: When dreamers escape from the Well of Infinite Dreams, dream fragments often follow them onto the material plane.
items.name: Dream Fragment

items.description: From dream to reality, memories become legends. This one tells part of Oto Mustam's story.
items.name: Legend of Oto Mustam

items.description: From dream to reality, memories become legends. This one tells part of the Mirror's story.
items.name: Legend of the Mirror

items.description: From dream to reality, memories become legends. This one tells part of Meriana's story.
items.name: Legend of Meriana

items.description: From dream to reality, memories become legends. This one tells part of Menalt's story.
items.name: Legend of Menalt

items.description: From dream to reality, memories become legends. This one tells part of Thanatena's story.
items.name: Legend of Thanatena

items.description: From dream to reality, memories become legends. This one tells part of Helsephine's story.
items.name: Legend of Helsephine

items.description: From dream to reality, memories become legends. This one tells part of Henual's story.
items.name: Legend of Henual

items.description: From dream to reality, memories become legends. This one tells part of Amayiro's story.
items.name: Legend of Amayiro

items.description: This fragment will allow you to put Brumen Tinctorias's map back together.
items.name: Fragment of Brumen's Map 4/4

items.description: This fragment will allow you to put Stellia's map back together.
items.name: Fragment of Stellia's Map 4/4

items.description: This sample of Mastoslob wool, charged with powerful MMOs (magically modified organisms), is much sought-after by curious Frigostians who want to understand how this young Mastogobbly could have evolved into his current form.
items.name: Mastoslob Wool

items.description: With the vast quantities of icefish he's constantly eating, Mister Penguin's clothes occasionally lose a button. That's why he always keeps a couple of spares on hand.
items.name: Mister Penguin Button

items.description: It's said that Katigger hair is an essential ingredient in a potion to restore the drinker's lust for life. One unfortunate side effect is that it also makes them bounce around constantly.
items.name: Katigger Hair

items.description: Many Frigostians are terrified of the Pirate Bhey spirit with which this fabric is infused, but if you really look at it, it's a lot cuter than you'd think.
items.name: Pirate Bhey Spectral Fabric

items.description: Thanks to you, the Masked Avenger has finally dropped her mask... and now it's broken.
items.name: Broken Masked Avenger Mask

items.description: Enutrofs and Srams use YeCh'Ti hairs to cover up their bare scalps.
items.name: YeCh'Ti Hair Tuft

items.description: This wool is as soft as Fuji Snowfoux's touch with her Snowfoux.
items.name: Fuji Snowfoux Wool

items.description: Flasho is as fast as lightning, but apparently not fast enough to avoid having it stolen from him.
items.name: Flasho Lightning Bolt

items.description: Plumbers aren't the only ones who get to have nice-looking moustaches – doctors can too!
items.name: Doctor Gobotnegg Moustache

items.description: This honey is so succulent, Frigostians cry frozen tears of joy over it.
items.name: Vinnie the Bearbarian Honey

items.description: This is just a fragment of the Ice Knight's soul. He probably won't mind, considering the state of it.
items.name: Ice Knight's Frozen Soul

items.description: Erotegg is a Sinistro with a big heart. Literally.
items.name: Erotegg Heart

items.description: This is no ordinary stinger – it's Actahive's stinger. So be careful, as even a slight prick from it could prove fatal.
items.name: Bearendizer Bee Stinger

items.description: Frigostians say that they use Mekstagob oil both in the kitchen and as a moisturising lotion. You're beginning to think they may have a bit of frostbite between the ears.
items.name: Mekstagob Oil

items.description: When Leatherbods let their leather bods get all leathery in bad weather.
items.name: Psychopump Leather

items.name: Mastoslob's Map

items.description: You think darkness is your ally? They were born in it, moulded by it. They didn't see the light until you arrived, and it was nothing to them but blinding.
items.name: Salt of the Depths

items.description: A precious stone of some value.
items.name: Quartz

items.description: A precious stone of some value.
items.name: Opal

items.description: A precious stone of some value.
items.name: Amazonite

items.description: A precious stone of some value.
items.name: Aventurine

items.description: A precious stone of some value.
items.name: Lapis

items.description: A precious stone of some value.
items.name: Onyx

items.description: A precious stone of some value.
items.name: Jet

items.description: Seasons come and go, but draconic coins are forever.
items.name: Draconic Coin

items.description: It's quite common for your bones to break (and run) when you're a Scalarcin.
items.name: Scalarcin Bone

items.description: Will the tooth fairy pay you a visit while you're sleeping, even if you've borrowed someone else's tooth? You'll have to try it and find out.
items.name: Marzwel Tooth

items.description: This cog is nothing without other cogs, because it forms part of a whole. But when it's in the right place, it works with unyielding efficiency. It also makes a sound that can't be mistaken, even deep in the ghetto: ratatata.
items.name: Qil Bil Cog

items.description: This claw has most likely torn apart more people than you've had friends in your entire life.
items.name: Tyranna Claw

items.description: This jewel is claimed to help its owner stop hearing the little voices in their head. There's no knowing if it actually works...
items.name: Scalptaras Jewel

items.description: It's said that Musha can eat without actually feeling hungry. That's because his eye seems to be directly linked to his stomach. Is that what it means when your eyes are bigger than your belly?
items.name: Musha Eyeball

items.description: This turquoise hair is much softer than a mufafah's, but when you see Simbadas's mouth open wide to tear off your arm, that's not really what will stick in your mind.
items.name: Simbadas Hair

items.description: Gold has always been a stable and worthwhile investment. With its recent increase in value, Rok Gnorok has had to keep an eye out for greedy adventurers who have it in for him.
items.name: Rok Gnorok Gold Tooth

items.description: This gunpowder can be highly explosive – it's the good stuff.
items.name: Carlita Gunpowder

items.description: You really did Naganita a disservice when you pulled out a tuft of her hair. She'll just have to barge into the nearest hair salon and demand some remedial scissor work.
items.name: Naganita Hair

items.description: This thing is spiky.
items.name: Spykting Spike

items.description: This flower is known for opening as soon as it is placed in water, filling ponds with a heady fragrance. In other words, the Lillyput has a strong smell.
items.name: War T'Lillyput Flower

items.description: The Transplents are crystal clear about one thing – they're absolutely against transplanting their marrow. No donation, no complication.
items.name: Transplent Marrow

items.description: It seems this tongue doesn't ever get tied.
items.name: Buddy Dubble Tongue

items.description: Apparently, some people would rather drink this sticky liquid than eat cabbage. It's hard to blame them.
items.name: Shushu Ptidoop Blood

items.description: Yes, it's horrible, but he'd have done the same thing to you if you hadn't won the fight.
items.name: Predagob Scalp

items.name: Breeding Dust

items.description: This token is proof of your exceptional work in the field of mount genetics.
items.name: Genetoken

items.description: According to legend, a dragoturkey is born with no more than two brain cells. Since this one was surgically extracted, the unlucky dragoturkey has just one left.
items.name: Dragoturkey Neuron

items.description: This incredibly stiff moustache isn't just useful for making seemyools look like wise elders – it's also a hydrodynamic sensor. Without it, seemyools would have no chance of swimming straight.
items.name: Orchid Seemyool Moustache

items.description: Contrary to what you might think, this slimy seemyool slobber isn't just some disgusting residue... It's affection in its purest form! It's said when a seemyool slobbers on its master, it's a sign of joy and loyalty.
items.name: Seemyool Slobber

items.description: These extremely sharp, rigid wings let rhineetles fly with tremendous speed. Be careful not to cut yourself when handling one, because even when detached from its owner, it still has a deadly cutting edge.
items.name: Ebony Rhineetle Wing

items.description: Rhineetles can use these claws to cling to any surface effortlessly... whether it be the smoothest ice on Frigost, the hardest rock on Crackler Mountain or even the sticky mud of mushds.

items.description: This mechanical contraption is designed to slap your mount across the face when it disobeys you. It used to be used in schools to teach young Iops to count to 5.
items.name: Bamboo Slapper

items.description: This drinking trough is a refreshing spot, a mount's paradise, it can either quench its thirst or have a quick dip if the season is hot. Filled with water and a few drops of magic potion, it will help your special friend grow big and strong.
items.name: Bamboo Drinking Trough

items.description: This terrifying wooden machine will launch a little lightning bolt at any creatures that get too close – which is the basis for the third most popular form of entertainment in the region. This machine is also great for increasing your mount's stamina – just tie it to its tail, sit back and enjoy the show!
items.name: Bamboo Lightning Thrower

items.description: This manger is the perfect gift for your trusty mount if you can find a happy balance between starving and overfeeding it. Take your mount to the manger when it begins to grow weak and it will take care of the rest.
items.name: Bamboo Manger

items.description:
"Tears fall from the silent protectors' eyes nourishing the flowers that in silence grow. Mauve petals of misfortune, they say. Mallow, does it leave your courage fallow? How cowardly."
— Belladonna
items.name: Sanctuary Protectors' Flower

items.description: Nothing's better than a stone visor to keep a stony face at all times. It'd be particularly useful when faced with your mother-in-law's snide remarks. As an added bonus, it'll likely send her round the bend.
items.name: Piece of Sanctuary Guardian Armour

items.description:
"Jealousy can lead to hatred. Embrace it. Cherish it. Don't be afraid to do your worst: a broken heart is better when combined with a good pummelling."
— Ephedra, fallen sovereign
items.name: Scarlet Queen's Broken Pommel

items.description:
"And let us join lianas,
let us bind groom and bride
within death, without life,
lianas make a beautiful bouquet
when they look so nice."
— Song from Ephedrya's Quest
items.name: Cursed Princess's Bouquet of Lianas

items.description: A rare resource of high value.
items.name: Moraympress Unit

items.description: A rare resource of high value.
items.name: Crabinator Grudge

items.description: A rare resource of high value.
items.name: Willorka Blackness

items.description: This venom is a combination of three powerful poisons. It's so concentrated, just one drop will make you go blind.
items.name: Moraympress Venom

items.description: This carapace seems to change shape randomly, only its structure doesn't, making it ultra-resistant.
items.name: Crabinator Carapace

items.description: Many poachers have attempted to hunt down Willorka for its fin. Very few have come back before quitting the profession.
items.name: Willorka Fin

items.description: When darkness surrounds you, cling to any glimmer you can see. No matter if it's a glimmer of hope or the glimmer of your enemies' eyes.
items.name: Abyssal Glimmer

items.description: A powerful pincer that can cut anything.
items.name: Crabinator Pincer

items.description:
"I was not the best because I struck quickly. I was the best because the crowd loved me. Win the crowd, Maximor, and you will win your freedom."

— Proximor, veteran gladiator.
items.name: Ovatoken
